result.topic_en: For the Gaussian primes m = 1+6i (norm 37), M = 5-4i (norm 41) and their product μ = 29+26i (norm 1517), the page tabulates the limits for x for each y from 1 to 27 (summing to 379), and then the distribution of the integers into residue classes modulo m and modulo M.

methods.what: Gaussian primes m and M with their norms (37, 41) and values of i modulo them (i ≡ 6 mod 37, i ≡ 32 mod 41); their product μ has norm 1517 and i ≡ 524 mod 1517
Counting lattice points x+iy in a region associated with μ: lower and upper limits of x tabulated for each y, counts summed in blocks of three rows
Total count of lattice points in the region
Distribution of the integers 1..36 into classes (0..3) with respect to m, in blocks of three
Distribution of the integers 1..40 into classes (0..3) with respect to M
